C1654.title: AvatarHunter: Non-Invasive De-Anonymization Attack Exploiting User Gait Features
C1654.summary: Researchers propose AvatarHunter, an attack method that non-invasively collects gait information by recording multi-view videos of a victim's virtual avatar in VR scenarios. In experiments on VRChat, it achieves a closed-world attack success rate of 92.1% and an open-world rate of 66.9%, enabling identification of the user's real identity without their awareness and bypassing avatar-based disguise

references.title: De-anonymization Attacks on Metaverse - IEEE Xplore
